description: NORO-GENO-01 canary cell B: norovirus non-GII.4-class monoprior (strain_evolution.prior_genotype_distribution {GII.17: 0.375, GII.2: 0.625} — the declared pre-era within-class split renormalized, the class is the measured unit) on the frozen fl_spr_12d cell of noro_rebase_01 at seeds 8105-8124 (20 seeds, paired with the NORO-REBASE-01 baseline canary). variant_surveillance armed at nominal mutation for per-class acquisition attribution and the strain_census; the class-conditioned secretor gate (0.10 GII.4 / 0.45 non-GII.4) is the discriminating readout. Design: docs/norovirus/noro_geno_01_design.md.

fl_spr_12d_nongii4.description: NORO-GENO-01 cell B: the frozen fl_spr_12d spirit_cruise_3000 12-day cell verbatim with the non-GII.4-class monoprior pinned and variant_surveillance armed. Run ids are shared with cells A/C; the S3 prefix and manifest carry cell identity.
